t: Din mi shebbadaq velo matza mispar kikkarot shehinniach
s: Din mi shebbadaq velo matza mispar kikkarot shehinniach ubo t' seipim: tisha tzibburim shel matztza veechad shel chametz shehayu munnachim lepanenu uba akbar venatal mehem kikkar echad bepanenu, velo yadanu im chametz natal o matztza natal veniknas labbayit bepanenu — tzarik lachazor velibdoq. Veen omerim "kol deparish merubba parish" umatztza natal, dekevan sherainu shennetalo, im ken nolad lanu hassapeq al kikkar zeh im hu chametz o matztza keshehaya adayin bimqom qebiut hechametz vehammatztza, dehaynu beshaa shennatal haakbar, vekol haqqabua dino kemechetza al mechetza, kemo sheddareshu chakamim mimmidrash happesuqim. Vaapillu im kebar bittel kol chametzo, sheen kan ella sepeq dibre soperim, vaapillu im hakkikkar shennatal haakbar haya qatan (a) sheyyesh litlot sheakalo haakbar, vahare yesh kan b' sepeqot lehaqel vehaya lanu lehaqel ap im lo bittel, ap al pi ken hechemiru chakamim kan ap im bittel, lepi shello heqellu chakamim besapeq echad im bittel ubeb' sepeqot im lo bittel ella bebayit shehu omed bechezqat baduq, shemmaamidin oto bechezqato velo hitrichuhu lachazor ulebodqo paam b', abal kol cheder shello nibdaq, ap al pi sheyyesh kamma sepeqot lepotro min habbediqa — en zeh moil kelum, shekkak hu iqqar taqqanat habbediqa libdoq apillu bimqomot sheen bahem chametz barur ella sapeq usepeq sepeqot, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g, ubayit zeh kevan sherainu shehiknis akbar kikkar letoko — hare hu omed bechezqat sheeno baduq, sheap shekkikkar zeh hu sepeq chametz sepeq matztza, mikkol maqom kevan shebbevadday niknas kikkar zeh shehu sepeq chametz lebayit zeh achar bediqato — hare nigrea chezqat bediqato, vehassapeq shehu matztza vehassapeq sheakalo haakbar enam moilim kelum, shekkak hi taqqanat chakamim libdoq bekol maqom sheeno bechezqat baduq ap al pi sheyyesh bo kamma sepeqot lehaqel. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheim hakkikkar haya qatan beinyan sheyyesh litlot sheakalo haakbar o sheyyoklennu adayin ad sheyyaggia zeman habbiur — en tzarik lachazor velibdoq apillu im lo bittelo, kevan sheyyesh kan b' sepeqot lehaqel, shemma matztza natal veshemma akalo kullo. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem im kebar bittel o sheyyakol adayin lebattel, sheaz habbediqa enah ella middibre soperim, ubedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:

Veim perash hakkikkar mimmeqom qebiato shello bepanenu umishsham netalo haakbar bepanenu veniknas lebayit baduq, kevan shennolad hassapeq al kikkar zeh im hu chametz o matztza leachar shepperash mimmeqom qebiut hechametz vehammatztza, shehare perash shello bepanenu — hare anu holekin achar harob, de"kol deparish merubba parish" umatztza hu, ulepikak apillu lo bittel ukebar higgia shaa shishshit veeno yakol lebattel, ap al pi ken en tzarik lachazor velibdoq apillu im hakkikkar hu gadol:

Veken im nitarebu hatztzibburim bimqom qebiutam, apillu natal akbar mehem bepanenu — en tzarik lachazor velibdoq, sheen zeh niqra qabua, kevan sheen hechametz omed bipne atzmo ella hu meorab im hammatztza:

Shene tzibburim echad shel chametz veechad shel matztza ushene battim echad baduq veechad sheeno baduq ubau shene akbarim zeh natal chametz vezeh natal matztza vekol echad niknas lebayit echad veen yadua leezeh bayit niknas zeh shennatal chametz, im kebar bittelo o sheyyekolim adayin lebattel, sheen kan ella sepeq dibre soperim, o shehu kikkar qatan sheyyesh kan b' sepeqot lehaqel — en tzarik lachazor velibdoq. Veap al pi shebbeshaa shenniknas kol kikkar lebayit echad nolad lo hassapeq al kol kikkar im hu chametz o matztza, veim ken hare yadua lanu shellekol bayit niknas kikkar sepeq chametz, ap al pi ken en habbayit omed bechezqat sheeno baduq, velo nigrea chezqat bediqato al yede sepeq chametz shenniknas letoko. Ella im ken nolad lo hassapeq keshehaya hakkikkar bemaqom sheqqabua sham chametz vadday, shehassapeq hannolad bimqom qebiat hechametz, kevan shehechemira bo tora shello lelek bo achar harob, sheap sheharob hu matztza ap al pi ken niddon kemechetza al mechetza — hechemiru bo chakamim gam ken veameru shessapeq zeh megarea chezqat bediqat habbayit. Abal shear sepeqot shello noledu bemaqom sheqqabua sham chametz vadday — lo hechemiru bahem chakamim kol kak sheyyotzi habbayit mechezqat bediqato:

Shene battim beduqim vetzibbur echad shel chametz uba akbar venatal veen yadua leezeh bayit niknas, im habbattim hen shel shene bene adam ubain lishol zeh achar zeh — shenehem en tzerikin lachazor velibdoq im bittelum o yekolin lebattel, vekol echad yakol litlot hechametz bebet chabero. Abal im lo bittelu veenan yekolin od lebattelo — shenehem tzerikin lachazor velibdoq apillu im haya kikkar qatan. Veen kan b' sepeqot lehaqel, lepi shessapeq zeh shemma lo niknas lebayit zeh o shemma lo niknas lebayit zeh eno necheshab lesapeq kelal min hattora, shebbevadday niknas leechad mehen, vekevan sheeno yadua ezehu — shenehem tzerikin bediqa, dehe minnayyahu mappeqat. Veap shebbau lishol zeh achar zeh — en zeh moil kelum min hattora, ella im ken bittelu, sheaz en tzarik libdoq ella middibre soperim, vachakamim heqellu bispeq dibrehem veameru, sheim bau lishol zeh achar zeh, kevan sheepshar lomar lekol echad shehu en tzarik libdoq lepi shehechametz hu bebet chabero — omerim ken. Abal im bau lishol bebat achat, o sheechad mehem shoel alayv veal bet chabero, kevan shei epshar lomar lahem sheshshenehem en tzerikin libdoq, shehare bebayit echad yesh vadday chametz, im ken shenehem tzerikin lachazor velibdoq, dehe minnayyahu mappeqat:

Akbar shenniknas lebayit veniknas acharayv ubadaq yapeh kekol hilkot bediqa velo matza kelum, apillu lo bittel en tzarik lachazor velibdoq, kevan shello metzao, vadday akalo haakbar o geraro lemaqom sheen yakol lehitgallot mishsham, velo yabo leoklo bepesach. Veim badaq qetzat habbayit umatza kikkar — en tzarik lachazor velibdoq shear habbayit im bittel o sheyyakol adayin lebattel, sheanu tolin lomar shezzehu hakkikkar shennatal haakbar. Abal im higgia shaa shishshit yesh lehachamir velibdoq, kevan sheeno yakol lebattel hare hu sapeq shel tora. Vaapillu im haya kikkar qatan en kan b' sepeqot lehaqel, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tl"ch:

Im hinniach asara kikkerot chametz qeshurim umatza t' veeno makkir im hen hen hakkikkarot shehinniach — tzarik libdoq kol habbayit o ad sheyyimtza asara kikkarot, lepi sheanu omerim mah shehinniach natelu qetannim o akbarim, shei epshar lahem lehattir haqqesher. Ulepikak, apillu bittel tzarik lachazor velibdoq kol habbayit, o ad sheyyimtza asara kikkarot. Abal im lo hayu qeshurim yachad — en tzarik libdoq ella ad sheyyimtza kikkar echad im bittel o sheyyakol lebattel:

Abal im hinniach tesha umatza eser, apillu lo hayu qeshurin — tzarik lachazor velibdoq kol habbayit, o ad sheyyimtza od tesha kikkarot, apillu kebar bittel kol hattesha kikkarot shehinniach, lepi shei epshar litlot lehaqel velomar shehen hen hattesha kikkarot harishonim vekikkar haasiri hebi ish acher vehinnicho kan, sheen derek bene adam lehanniach kikkerotehem etzel kikkere chabrehem, ella meyachadim lahem maqom leatzman shello yitarebu, lepikak anu omerim shebba ish acher shehayu beyado asara kikkarot vehinnichan kan shello haya munnach kan kelum, ki hat' harishonim kebar laqechu mikkan, sheggerarum qetannim o akbarim, ulekak tzarik lachazor velibdoq kol habbayit, o ad sheyyimtza od tisha kikkarot:

Hinniach kikkarot bezavit zo umatza bezavit acheret — tzarik lachazor velibdoq kol habbayit, shemma ellu acherim hen kevan shemmetzaan bemaqom acher, veharishonim netalum qetannim o akbarim vehinnichum bemaqom acher beoto habbayit. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheeno yodea minyan hakkikkarot shehinniach, abal im yodea minyan hakkikkarot umatza bezavit acheret kamminyan shehinniach — en tzarik libdoq im bittel o sheyyakol adayin lebattel, kevan shehabbediqa enah ella middibre soperim — anu tolin lehaqel shemmin hassetam hen hen hakkikkarot shehinniach, kevan shehen shavin beminyanam:
